payload.friendly_name: Gherkin authoring aids and Specification layout
payload.purpose_context: Feature pages generated from Gherkin are a core DocKitty surface. Authors get no feedback when steps describe UI clicks instead of behaviour, must repeat a glossary context tag in every file of a bounded-context folder, and readers cannot see a page's tags, source or draft status. This mission adds an opt-in wording check, a per-folder default glossary context, and a Specification layout with a draft notice for every draft page (issues #196, #197, #198).
payload.purpose_tldr: Help authors write feature files that read well as living documentation, and give generated feature pages a layout that shows their status, tags and source.

payload.question: #196 (D1): Which surfaces does the imperative-step lint check?

payload.final_answer: Pages + in-page: one pure core called from feature-page generation and in-page gherkin fences; includes silent; raw fences never (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)

payload.question: #196 (D2): How broad is the default verb list?

payload.final_answer: Narrow phrases: phrase-anchored English list plus CSS-selector signal; enter/select/submit documented as opt-in extend entries (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)

payload.question: #196 (D3): Which keyword types are checked by default?

payload.final_answer: Given + When (context + action), configurable; And/But inherit (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)

payload.question: #196 (D4): Ship a suppression tag in v1?

payload.final_answer: @dk:allow=imperative at Feature, Rule or Scenario level (contract change, ADR) (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)

payload.question: #197 (D5): Where does the folder default come from?

payload.final_answer: New gherkin option map, mirroring gherkin.titles, with a repeatable CLI flag (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)

payload.question: #197 (D6): How do folder keys match nested folders?

payload.final_answer: Nearest parent: segment-wise longest-prefix match (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)
Warn for unknown context values from both the map and @dk:context tags (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)
defaultGlossaryContext (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)

Sidebar + header card: keep the On this page TOC as the scenario list; add a header spec card; amend #198 wording (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)
Every draft page, driven by doc_status (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)
Default for kind: Specification via base manifest; theme per-kind opt-out (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)
Build now on --dk-* tokens; add the layout to #104's migration list (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)

One mission, one PR; order #197 -> #196 -> #198; two ADRs; research PR #213 folded in; side findings handled (fix #113 pointer, file kind-contract and double-h1 issues) (operator answer, interview via AskUserQuestion on 2026-10-19, collected before the mission scaffold existed)

Does the Engineering Alignment summary hold?

options: Keep it in the body only
payload.question: The ADR-0055 overlay already renders a results summary near the top of each generated page body. Should the Specification card also show one?

payload.final_answer: Body only (operator, 2026-10-19): the card shows tags and source link; the ADR-0055 results summary stays in the body where the overlay places it. FR-014 and US3 scenario 2 amended.
